title: LUMA: Personal AI Desktop Assistant
short_desc: A local-first personal AI assistant with a matte green HUD. Wake it by voice ("Luma") or keyboard, then chat, pull up a live world feed, use the camera, run commands in its own terminal or control music — all from one desktop app.
blueprint_desc: The frontend is a PyQt6 desktop app built around a central animated core and five modules on a bottom dock: World Feed (live TV stream, market ticker and chart, top story and headlines), Chat (voice or text, with draggable glass-style panels), Optic (live camera view), Terminal (Luma's own commands and skills) and Music (Spotify now-playing and playback control). Replies come from a local model via Ollama today; the long-term plan is to swap in LUMA Brain, a small language model I am building from scratch and training on my own data and Luma's tools. The source code is currently private.
